810: /****************************************************************************
811:  * Name: agent_camera_capture
812:  *
813:  * Description:
814:  *   The capture half of tool_camera.c's camera_v4l2_capture(), with the
815:  *   frame count made a parameter so a single session can be watched for
816:  *   more than one frame.  The tool takes exactly one.
817:  *
818:  ****************************************************************************/
819: 
820: static int agent_camera_capture(struct agent_camera_s *cam,
821:                                 int width, int height,
822:                                 unsigned int count, bool negotiate,
823:                                 const char *out_path, bool b64,
824:                                 bool b64_all, unsigned int rec)
825: {
826:   enum v4l2_buf_type type = V4L2_BUF_TYPE_VIDEO_CAPTURE;
827:   struct v4l2_requestbuffers req;
828:   struct v4l2_capability cap;
829:   struct timeval t_start;
830:   struct timeval t_end;
831:   unsigned long elapsed_ms;
832:   FAR uint8_t **rec_frames = NULL;
833:   FAR size_t *rec_lens = NULL;
834:   unsigned int rec_stored = 0;
835:   unsigned int rec_every = 1;
836:   uint32_t chosen_fmt = 0;
837:   unsigned int frame;
838:   uint32_t i;
839:   int ret;
840: 
841:   memset(&cap, 0, sizeof(cap));
842:   if (ioctl(cam->fd, VIDIOC_QUERYCAP, (uintptr_t)&cap) < 0)
843:     {
844:       printf("agent_camera: VIDIOC_QUERYCAP failed: %d\n", errno);
845:       return -errno;
846:     }
847: 
848:   if ((cap.capabilities & V4L2_CAP_VIDEO_CAPTURE) == 0)
849:     {
850:       printf("agent_camera: device reports no capture capability "
851:              "(caps=0x%08" PRIx32 ")\n", (uint32_t)cap.capabilities);
852:       return -ENODEV;
853:     }
854: 
855:   ret = agent_camera_set_format(cam->fd, &width, &height, negotiate,
856:                                 &chosen_fmt);
857:   if (ret < 0)
858:     {
859:       return ret;
860:     }
861: 
862:   printf("agent_camera: format ");
863:   agent_camera_print_fourcc(chosen_fmt);
864:   printf(" %dx%d sizeimage=%d\n", width, height, CAM_BUF_SIZE);
865: 
866:   memset(&req, 0, sizeof(req));
867:   req.count  = g_nbufs;
868:   req.type   = V4L2_BUF_TYPE_VIDEO_CAPTURE;
869:   req.memory = V4L2_MEMORY_MMAP;
870: 
871:   if (ioctl(cam->fd, VIDIOC_REQBUFS, (uintptr_t)&req) < 0)
872:     {
873:       printf("agent_camera: VIDIOC_REQBUFS failed: %d\n", errno);
874:       return -errno;
875:     }
876: 
877:   cam->nbuffers = req.count < CAM_MAX_BUFFERS ? req.count : CAM_MAX_BUFFERS;
878:   printf("agent_camera: %" PRIu32 " buffer(s) granted\n", cam->nbuffers);
879: 
880:   for (i = 0; i < cam->nbuffers; i++)
881:     {
882:       struct v4l2_buffer buf;
883: 
884:       memset(&buf, 0, sizeof(buf));
885:       buf.type   = V4L2_BUF_TYPE_VIDEO_CAPTURE;
886:       buf.memory = V4L2_MEMORY_MMAP;
887:       buf.index  = i;
888: 
889:       if (ioctl(cam->fd, VIDIOC_QUERYBUF, (uintptr_t)&buf) < 0)
890:         {
891:           printf("agent_camera: VIDIOC_QUERYBUF(%" PRIu32 ") failed: %d\n",
892:                  i, errno);
893:           return -errno;
894:         }
895: 
896:       cam->buflen[i] = buf.length;
897:       cam->bufs[i] = mmap(NULL, buf.length, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
898:                           MAP_SHARED, cam->fd, buf.m.offset);
899:       if (cam->bufs[i] == MAP_FAILED)
900:         {
901:           cam->bufs[i] = NULL;
902:           printf("agent_camera: mmap(%" PRIu32 ", %zu) failed: %d\n",
903:                  i, cam->buflen[i], errno);
904:           return -errno;
905:         }
906: 
907:       printf("agent_camera: buffer[%" PRIu32 "] len=%zu at %p\n",
908:              i, cam->buflen[i], cam->bufs[i]);
909:     }
910: 
911:   for (i = 0; i < cam->nbuffers; i++)
912:     {
913:       struct v4l2_buffer buf;
914: 
915:       memset(&buf, 0, sizeof(buf));
916:       buf.type   = V4L2_BUF_TYPE_VIDEO_CAPTURE;
917:       buf.memory = V4L2_MEMORY_MMAP;
918:       buf.index  = i;
919: 
920:       if (ioctl(cam->fd, VIDIOC_QBUF, (uintptr_t)&buf) < 0)
921:         {
922:           printf("agent_camera: VIDIOC_QBUF(%" PRIu32 ") failed: %d\n",
923:                  i, errno);
924:           return -errno;
925:         }
926:     }
927: 
928:   if (ioctl(cam->fd, VIDIOC_STREAMON, (uintptr_t)&type) < 0)
929:     {
930:       printf("agent_camera: VIDIOC_STREAMON failed: %d\n", errno);
931:       return -errno;
932:     }
933: 
934:   cam->streaming = true;
935: 
936:   /* Wall clock across the streaming session, so the session reports the
937:    * frame rate it actually achieved rather than the 30fps the sensor is
938:    * configured for.  Note that 'b64all' prints tens of kilobytes per
939:    * frame down a 115200 console, which dominates everything else; take
940:    * the rate from a run without it.
941:    */
942: 
943:   /* Recording mode keeps the frames instead of printing them, so the
944:    * capture runs at the sensor's rate and the console work happens
945:    * afterwards.  Printing inside the loop cannot do that: one frame of
946:    * base64 is ~40KB, i.e. 3.5s at 115200, so every "next" frame would be
947:    * whatever the driver had most recently overwritten and the clip would be
948:    * a time lapse rather than motion.  The frames come from the heap, which
949:    * on this board reaches into PSRAM (6MB), so 30 x ~30KB is affordable
950:    * while the 300KB SRAM heap alone would not be.
951:    */
952: 
953:   if (rec > 0)
954:     {
955:       /* Keep rec frames out of the count captured, spread evenly.  Copying
956:        * a frame out costs more than the 33ms between frames at 640x480 --
957:        * both ends are non-cacheable PSRAM -- so recording every frame loses
958:        * the race with the DMA and most scans come back truncated (measured:
959:        * 2 to 11 clean out of 30).  Sampling every rec_every'th frame buys
960:        * that many frame times per copy, and the result is still a real
961:        * recording: the frames are the sensor's own, spaced by a known
962:        * interval, just at a lower rate than 30fps.
963:        */
964: 
965:       rec_every = count > rec ? count / rec : 1;
966: 
967:       rec_frames = (FAR uint8_t **)calloc(rec, sizeof(FAR uint8_t *));
968:       rec_lens = (FAR size_t *)calloc(rec, sizeof(size_t));
969:       if (rec_frames == NULL || rec_lens == NULL)
970:         {
971:           printf("agent_camera: cannot hold %u frames\n", rec);
972:           free(rec_frames);
973:           free(rec_lens);
974:           return -ENOMEM;
975:         }
976:     }
977: 
978:   gettimeofday(&t_start, NULL);
979: 
980:   for (frame = 0; frame < count; frame++)
981:     {
982:       struct pollfd pfd;
983:       struct v4l2_buffer dqbuf;
984:       int nready;
985: 
986:       pfd.fd     = cam->fd;
987:       pfd.events = POLLIN;
988: 
989:       nready = poll(&pfd, 1, CAM_TIMEOUT_MS);
990:       if (nready < 0)
991:         {
992:           printf("agent_camera: poll failed: %d\n", errno);
993:           return -errno;
994:         }
995: 
996:       if (nready == 0)
997:         {
998:           printf("agent_camera: no frame within %d ms -- the capture path "
999:                  "produced nothing\n", CAM_TIMEOUT_MS);
1000:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
1001:         }
1002: 
1003:       memset(&dqbuf, 0, sizeof(dqbuf));
1004:       dqbuf.type   = V4L2_BUF_TYPE_VIDEO_CAPTURE;
1005:       dqbuf.memory = V4L2_MEMORY_MMAP;
1006: 
1007:       if (ioctl(cam->fd, VIDIOC_DQBUF, (uintptr_t)&dqbuf) < 0)
1008:         {
1009:           printf("agent_camera: VIDIOC_DQBUF failed: %d\n", errno);
1010:           return -errno;
1011:         }
1012: 
1013:       printf("agent_camera: frame %u: index=%" PRIu32
1014:              " bytesused=%" PRIu32 " flags=0x%08" PRIx32 "\n",
1015:              frame, (uint32_t)dqbuf.index, (uint32_t)dqbuf.bytesused,
1016:              (uint32_t)dqbuf.flags);
1017: 
1018:       /* The driver completes a buffer with V4L2_BUF_FLAG_ERROR when its
1019:        * watchdog fires rather than leaving DQBUF blocked forever (see
1020:        * invariant 8 in docs/reference/camera.md).  Such a buffer carries no
1021:        * usable frame, so say so instead of validating its contents.
1022:        */
1023: 
1024:       if ((dqbuf.flags & V4L2_BUF_FLAG_ERROR) != 0)
1025:         {
1026:           printf("agent_camera: buffer flagged ERROR -- capture watchdog "
1027:                  "or encoder fault, contents not usable\n");
1028:         }
1029:       else if (dqbuf.bytesused == 0)
1030:         {
1031:           printf("agent_camera: empty frame\n");
1032:         }
1033:       else if (dqbuf.index < cam->nbuffers)
1034:         {
1035:           const uint8_t *data = cam->bufs[dqbuf.index];
1036: 
1037:           /* Get the bytes out of the capture buffer *first*, before anything
1038:            * else touches them.  agent_camera_check_jpeg() walks the whole
1039:            * frame looking for markers, and doing that in place -- byte at a
1040:            * time, out of non-cacheable PSRAM -- costs more than the 33ms the
1041:            * sensor leaves between frames, so the DMA catches up and the scan
1042:            * we then copy is already truncated.  Measured: validating first
1043:            * gave 11 of 29 frames a clean decode, copying first gives the
1044:            * numbers quoted in the recording section of the docs.
1045:            */
1046: 
1047:           if (rec > 0 && rec_stored < rec && (frame % rec_every) == 0)
1048:             {
1049:               FAR uint8_t *copy = (FAR uint8_t *)malloc(dqbuf.bytesused);
1050: 
1051:               if (copy == NULL)
1052:                 {
1053:                   printf("agent_camera: out of memory at frame %u, "
1054:                          "recording %u frame(s)\n", frame, rec_stored);
1055:                   rec = rec_stored;
1056:                 }
1057:               else
1058:                 {
1059:                   agent_camera_copy32(copy, data, dqbuf.bytesused);
1060:                   rec_frames[rec_stored] = copy;
1061:                   rec_lens[rec_stored] = dqbuf.bytesused;
1062:                   rec_stored++;
1063: 
1064:                   /* Validate the copy, not the live buffer. */
1065: 
1066:                   data = copy;
1067:                 }
1068:             }
1069: 
1070:           agent_camera_check_jpeg(data, dqbuf.bytesused);
1071: 
1072:           /* Deliver the *last* frame of the session, not the first.
1073:            *
1074:            * This used to take frame 0, which is the one frame guaranteed to
1075:            * be affected by the startup transient: the encoder is enabled at
